```{r}
#saveRDS(all_out_lists, file = paste0(exp_path, "combined_out_lists.rds"))
all_out_lists <- readRDS(paste0(exp_path, "combined_out_lists.rds"))

method_names <- c(
  "fixed_crn" = "fCRN",      
  "adaptive_crn"  = "aCRN",
  "fixed_het"      = "fHet",
  "adaptive_het"   = "aHet",
  "fixed_crn_seed" = "fgCRN"
)
```


Compute the number of trajectories below threshold across experiments:
```{r}
threshold_counts <- function(out_list, sim_budget=200, nout=5, thresholds=c(15, 20, 25, 30)) {
  outs <- names(out_list)[1:nout]
  all_results <- list()
  k = 1
  for (i in seq_along(outs)) {
    out_name <- outs[i]
    out <- out_list[[out_name]]
    for (j in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      t <- thresholds[j]
      cnt <- sum(out$y_rmse[1:sim_budget]<t)
      res <- list(method=out_name, threshold=t, num_trajectories=cnt)
      res <- cbind(data.frame(res), out_list$config)
      res$sim_budget <- sim_budget # overwrite
      all_results[[k]] <- res
      k = k+1
    }
  }
  return(do.call(rbind, all_results))
}

df_threshold <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c(300, 500, 700), function(b) {
    do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(all_out_lists, function(x) {
        threshold_counts(x, sim_budget = b)
      })
    )
  })
)

df_threshold <- merge(df_threshold, config[,sim_budget:=NULL])
df_threshold$method <- factor(method_names[df_threshold$method], levels=c("aCRN", "fHet", "aHet", "fgCRN", "fCRN"))
```


Track individual hyperparameter combinations for plotting:
```{r}
hyper_designs <- df_threshold %>% 
  select(sim_budget, init_npar, nrep, grid_npar, nTS_samp) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    exp_design = row_number(),
    initial_sims = init_npar * nrep,
    sampling_size = grid_npar * nTS_samp)

hyper_designs
```


Overall figure for trajectories found (across experiments):
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=2}
# Suppose your data.frame is called df with columns: 
#   budget (200/500/700), 
#   threshold (15/20/25/30), 
#   method (adaptive_crn, …), 
#   prop_under (numeric proportion from each run)

# First compute summary stats:
df_threshold$pct_traj <- df_threshold$num_trajectories/df_threshold$sim_budget

# Aggregate over designs 
df_summary <- merge(df_threshold, hyper_designs) %>%
  group_by(sim_budget, threshold, method, exp_design) %>%
  summarise(pct_traj=mean(pct_traj)) %>%
  group_by(sim_budget, threshold, method) %>%
  summarize(
    median_prop = median(pct_traj),
    iqr_lower   = quantile(pct_traj, 0.25),
    iqr_upper   = quantile(pct_traj, 0.75),
    mean_prop = mean(pct_traj),
    se_lower = mean(pct_traj) - sd(pct_traj)/sqrt(n()),
    se_upper = mean(pct_traj) + sd(pct_traj)/sqrt(n())
  )
df_summary
```
```{r}
# Then plot
p <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = threshold, y = median_prop, color = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = iqr_lower, ymax = iqr_upper, fill = method),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ sim_budget, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(15, 20, 25, 30)) +
  labs(
    x = "Threshold (RMSE)",
    y = "Median Proportion of Budget Under Threshold",
    color = "Method",
    fill = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

df_pairs <- df_threshold %>% filter(threshold == 30)
df_pairs <- merge(df_pairs, hyper_designs)

# Create parsed labels as character strings (to be parsed later)
df_pairs$sim_budget_lab <- paste0("N[max]==", df_pairs$sim_budget)
df_pairs$init_cost_lab  <- paste0("N[0]==", df_pairs$initial_sims)

df_pairs$pct_traj <- df_pairs$num_trajectories / df_pairs$sim_budget

p <- ggplot(df_pairs) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = method, y = pct_traj, fill = factor(initial_sims), color = factor(initial_sims))) +
  facet_wrap(~sim_budget_lab, labeller = label_parsed) +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Proportion under threshold",
    fill = expression(N[0]),
    color = expression(N[0])
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("50" = "#132B43", "100" = "#306490", "200" = "#56B1F7")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("50" = "#132B43", "100" = "#306490", "200" = "#56B1F7")
  )

ggsave("initial_design.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
df_pairs <- df_threshold %>% filter(threshold == 20)
df_pairs <- merge(df_pairs, hyper_designs)

df_pairs$pct_traj <- df_pairs$num_trajectories / df_pairs$sim_budget
#df_pairs$sim_budget_lab <- paste0("N[max]==", df_pairs$sim_budget)

# Use factors for both fill and facet variables
df_pairs$initial_sims <- factor(df_pairs$initial_sims)
df_pairs$sim_budget <- factor(df_pairs$sim_budget)

# Final plot
ggplot(df_pairs) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = method, y = pct_traj, fill = initial_sims)) +
  facet_wrap(~sim_budget, labeller = label_bquote(cols = N[max] == .(sim_budget))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Initial design",
    values = c("50" = "darkgreen", "100" = "gold", "200" = "tomato"),
    labels = c(expression(N[0] == 50), expression(N[0] == 100), expression(N[0] == 200))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Proportion under threshold")

```

```{r}
df_pairs <- df_threshold %>% filter(sim_budget==700, threshold==20)

df_melt <- melt(df_pairs %>% select(method, num_trajectories, init_npar, nrep, grid_npar, nTS_samp), 
               id.vars=c('method', 'num_trajectories'), 
               variable.name='experimental_unit', 
               value.name = 'value')

p <- ggplot(df_melt) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=factor(value), y=num_trajectories, color=method, fill=method))+
```
